Material artwork only: even diffuse illumination with no cast shadows, ground plane, dirt backdrop, labels, text or frame.
Follow the exact unusual UV layout of input 1, including all blank coverage. Exact square canvas; no added margins, no view reordering, no perspective correction. Registration accuracy is essential.
